summary: Non-deterministic workflow history occurs when an update handler executes on cold-start/replay before a signal handler's activity-awaiting coroutine completes, causing the update to read stale shared state.
userImpact: Users with complex workflows using updates, signals, and timers in specific configurations may experience non-deterministic history errors during replay on cold starts.
rootCause: During cold start/replay, the update handler is executed before the signal handler's coroutine advances past the activity await to finalize the shared state flag.
keyQuote: It looks like the update handler gets executed before the recorded signal handler has completed its work.
